source: S2b Pass B (lookfor-scope-plan.md): below-floor cards outside produce
format: apply.mjs row, one per card+field: {id, field, remove:[exact], add:[{text, field, quote}], to_watch_out:[exact], kept_in?:[{text, field, quote}]}. Runs after out/deletions.patch.json. Each add.quote is verbatim in that card (add.field names where) before the run; kept_in shows where each removed safety fact still reads on the card (informational, apply ignores it).
